_readme: The tower's channels.json with the daily programme switched on (docs/PROGRAMME.md). To use it: copy it to channels.json in the music folder (Radio Tower\music\channels.json), then node library\bot.mjs publish, then restart the tower once. The programme block holds the rules; edit them and publish again — they take over at the next 05:00 Paris time. The channels after Everything are the streams (Chill, Energy): each is its own clock over the folders and labels it names, and a change to them takes effect at the tower's next scan.

channels.label: Everything
channels.blurb: Favourites every day, the loop every other day, the albums mixed in turn. A new day at 05:00 Paris time.

channels.label: Chill
channels.blurb: Slow and quiet. For working, reading, or nothing at all.
channels._why: Arthur, 10/11/2026: two streams beside Everything, one chill, one more energetic, on the dial now and empty until he fills them. To fill it: drop music in a Chill folder at the top of the library, or add any folders already on the tower to the list below ("Crates/Bandcamp/an album"). "genres": ["jazz"] also brings in everything with that label (match any = by folder OR by label). excludeFolders takes things out. keepEmpty keeps it on the dial, marked as waiting, while it holds nothing.

channels.label: Energy
channels._why: Same rules as Chill, with an Energy folder.
